description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers running the analysis loops and councils on an existing pull request, feedback by default or applying fixes with --optimize. Should-not-trigger covers the neighbours that own a different surface: /review:changes (the working tree before a PR exists), /council:pr (one council opinion, no loops), /pr:merge (merging), /fix:pr-comments (answering review comments) and /create-pr (opening a PR).
